# Donzen Accounting Hub

> Nigeria's premier SME accounting firm, bookkeeping agency, and digital accounting academy founded by Samuel Onainor.

## About
Donzen Accounting Hub provides professional bookkeeping, monthly financial statement preparation, tax consultation and filing (CIT, WHT, VAT, PAYE), inventory control, internal audits, CAC business registrations, and practical accounting software training across Nigeria and West Africa.

- **Website**: https://www.donzenaccountinghub.com
- **Headquarters**: Ikota Shopping Complex, Lekki, Lagos State, Nigeria
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +234 703 9999 842
- **Email**: info@donzenaccountinghub.com
- **Founder & Lead Consultant**: Samuel Onainor

## Core Services & Offerings
- **Monthly Bookkeeping & Financial Reporting**: Real-time record keeping, bank reconciliations, profit & loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports.
- **Tax Compliance & Filing**: Corporate Income Tax (CIT), Value Added Tax (VAT), Withholding Tax (WHT), and Personal Income Tax (PAYE) calculation and FIRS/LIRS compliance.
- **Accounting Academy & Practical Courses**: Step-by-step masterclasses on practical bookkeeping, QuickBooks Online, Sage 50, Excel for Accountants, and financial analysis.
- **Course Bundles**: Multi-course bundled packages offered with scheduled cohort batch enrollment and access duration options.
- **Business Toolkits & Excel Templates**: Ready-to-use automated bookkeeping workbooks, invoicing spreadsheets, payroll calculators, and inventory logs.
